rule: An older customer.subscription.updated (period end 2026-01-01) must not roll back the period end set by the newer one (2026-02-01)
invariant: SELECT current_period_ends <> '2026-01-01' FROM account WHERE id=1
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.

statements: UPDATE account SET stripe_subscription_id='sub_1',current_period_ends='2026-01-01',ai_gen_count=0 WHERE id=1 AND current_period_ends<='2026-01-01'
UPDATE account SET stripe_subscription_id='sub_1',current_period_ends='2026-02-01',ai_gen_count=0 WHERE id=1 AND current_period_ends<='2026-02-01'
